verdict.rationale: First-party docs clearly describe delegating larger tasks in ChatGPT Work that are carried through to a reviewable result. They also cover running long-running and parallel work from the desktop workspace, starting separate tasks and checking their progress, Goal mode, delegation to subagents, and background tasks with a review view for completed runs. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that background autonomous tasks work as described, and deeper detail on Goal mode's long-running behavior.
